Originally established to watch over [[the Mouth of Torment]], Morah was ever a haunted place. It was abandoned two hundred years after its founding, succumbing to the spread of the desert. Recent ruptures from the crater have further destroyed this once majestic city as the [[Realm of Torment]] seeps in through the cracks in reality.}} The crumbling ruins of an ancient city known as [[Ruins of Morah (outpost)|Morah]] litter the surroundings of this outpost. Little is known about what this city once was and who had once ruled or resided here prior to its fall. The storyline continues as the players track [[Varesh Ossa]] to this location. ==Getting there== The [[primary quest]] [[Horde of Darkness]] will conclude by talking to [[Captain Mehhan]] and the party will be brought to this outpost. (Note that the way to this outpost is blocked before finishing that quest.)
